target_boundary: Explain how Arcanum arrives at the SCU concept through invoke, work-packs, implementation layering, distill, refine, and task-session execution boundaries.

reader_contract.target_public: A reader who has heard Arcanum terms but does not yet know why each sigil or spell exists.
assumed_knowledge: The reader knows that Arcanum contains reusable sigils and spells.
The reader can read a simple left-to-right workflow diagram.
reader_contract.reader_reward: The reader can explain why SCU exists and how the method moves from vague intent to bounded execution.

must_start_with: Start from the user's problem: vague work becomes risky when it jumps straight into execution.
Introduce SCU only after showing the two pressures that create it.
must_not_start_with: Do not begin with a bare glossary definition of SCU.
Do not assume the reader knows invoke, work-packs, implementation layering, distill, or refine.
opening_contract.failure_message: If the page starts with jargon, it fails the reader contract.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: Smallest Coherent Unit: the smallest part that still has meaning, responsibility, inputs, outputs, and a way to recompose upward.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: It prevents both tiny fragments that cannot be used and giant bundles that cannot be safely executed.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: Do not treat SCU as the smallest possible fragment; it must remain coherent.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: The authoring front door that turns intent into define, design, plan, work-pack, handoff, or refresh artifacts.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: It gives vague work a governed starting surface before lifecycle execution begins.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: Invoke authors artifacts and handoff context; it does not own every downstream lifecycle.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: An executable planning artifact that carries objective, tasks, SWUs, validation, gates, write scope, and evidence expectations.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: It is the bridge between a designed method and a bounded worker action.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: A work-pack is not execution by itself; it makes later execution accountable.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: Smallest Working Unit: the smallest executable implementation step with one parent task, write scope, done criteria, and verification.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: It makes execution handoff assignable without reopening design discovery.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: An SWU is executable scope; an SCU is conceptual coherence.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: A staged plan that starts with Layer 0, the minimum working proof, then adds layers only when they unlock a distinct decision.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: It explains the proof pressure behind SCU: what is the smallest slice that teaches us the concept can work?
reader_terms.misuse_warning: Do not add a layer because it feels complete; add it when it unlocks a distinct decision.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: A reduction loop that finds the smallest coherent concept unit and proves it can recompose into the larger system.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: It explains the meaning pressure behind SCU: what is still coherent after we make it smaller?
reader_terms.misuse_warning: Do not reduce below closure; the unit still needs responsibility, inputs, outputs, and recomposition.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: A discovery and design loop for vague targets, design concerns, repository areas, or existing work-packs.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: It catches ambiguity and repairs the route before premature execution.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: Refine produces seed, design, or plan shape; mutation still needs the next owning route.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: A guided execution loop for one bounded task or SWU with context, gates, validation, and evidence sync.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: It shows where the method becomes action, and why one ready unit matters.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: Task Session should stop before mutation when context, write scope, or validation is unsafe.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As a newcomer, I want the method to start from a practical problem.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: Vague work needs a method before execution because otherwise scope, evidence, and done criteria blur together.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As a newcomer, I want to see the method as a sequence.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: Invoke authors the plan, work-packs carry execution shape, layering asks for minimum proof, distill asks for coherent unit, refine repairs ambiguity, and task-session executes one bounded unit.
layer_reader_outcomes.because_it_matters_for: understanding how SCU emerges instead of memorizing the term.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As a working reader, I want to know why each capability hands off.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: Ownership boundaries keep authoring, concept selection, execution planning, and mutation from collapsing into one artifact.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As a working reader, I want to know what the method depends on outside the diagram.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: Source evidence, approval, validation surfaces, write scope, and runtime reality are outside constraints that shape safe execution.
layer_reader_outcomes.because_it_matters_for: separating method explanation from runtime proof.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As a reviewer, I want to see what happens after the candidate unit is named.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: A candidate SCU becomes durable only when it can move through planning, execution, validation, evidence sync, and reflection.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As a reviewer, I want uncertainty named separately from facts.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: The unit may be too tiny, too broad, under-evidenced, or confused with an executable SWU.
layer_reader_outcomes.because_it_matters_for: keeping SCU useful rather than vague jargon.
